subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: What information may OpenClaw expose from an unapproved group before its owner grants approval?
rationale: Join metadata, message bodies, and sandboxed agent execution create materially different privacy, prompt-injection, retention, and authorization boundaries that source inspection cannot choose.

options.title: Metadata only
options.body: Create a pending approval from channel-provided join metadata and drop every message until approval.

options.title: First-message metadata
options.body: Create a pending approval when the first message arrives but retain only group and sender identifiers plus display metadata.

options.title: Restricted content reader
options.body: Allow an explicitly configured restricted agent to process message bodies before approval.

recommendation.title: Metadata only
recommendation.body: Create a pending approval from channel-provided join metadata and drop every message until approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior design review and has the strongest recent history across the shared authorization and group-policy boundary.
